latestTerminalSummary:
Reviewed the complete `f57db33… → 0f67f301…` diff, frozen R4 evidence, and pinned std/hashbrown sources. Frozen checksums and all 20 retained source-file hashes match.

**One required coverage fix (P2): missing-work mutation after cleanup handoff is not isolated.** In [lifetime_tests.rs:74](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-361487a2/rust/core/src/source_resources/lifetime_tests.rs:74), the backend is cancelled before mutation is attempted, so cancellation alone guarantees refusal. The healthy-backend test in [authority_tests.rs:225](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-361487a2/rust/core/src/source_resources/authority_tests.rs:225) exercises allocation only.

Add independent cases that retain spare Vec/map capacity, end the original work, perform cleanup-only handoff, and attempt `try_push`, occupied-key replacement, and pre-reserved insertion without destination work. Assert Coverage refusal, unchanged contents/backing/accounting, and successful cleanup. These would catch removal of the operation checks even when no allocator callback occurs. The current implementation has those checks; this is a proof gap, not an observed mutation defect.

I found **no concrete source-level memory-safety or default/raw regression blocker**:

- Pointer/Layout delegation remains unchanged through `Global`; admission precedes allocation, deallocation precedes refund, and resize admits full new storage alongside old storage.
- Standard Arc/Weak owns control-block lifetime; allocator clones preserve the refund domain without allocating.
- Both R3 fixes are implemented: Box Layout prevalidation with initialized-prefix cleanup, and authority-free cleanup moves preserving backing/account.
- Authority uses actual decoder/work state and owned snapshots without aliased mutable decoder access. Revision validation remains explicitly generation-coupled, not complete production cache authorization.
- Prototype code remains private and feature-plus-unit-test gated. No parser or public owner replacement occurs. Metadata limits and excluded baseline overhead are declared.

**Qualification remains pending.** Parent validation must compile and execute the opted-in core unit-test target, run default and feature-unified workspace tests and strict Clippy, verify locked dependency resolution, and check wasm feature compatibility. A feature-only library build does not compile this prototype. Global-error rollback remains source-reviewed only; admission refusal does not exercise that branch.

All 28 behavioral tests, compiler feasibility, Clippy, wasm, and performance remain **UNRUN**. No edits, builds, tests, jobs, GitHub actions, or delegation were performed. Closed admission and active jobs were preserved.

This checkpoint provides no approval for production activation or broad owner/cache migration; the major Rust API migration and platform-wide capability/output qualification remain outstanding.
